cases.sentence: Иаков продолжил путешествие и пришел в землю ___.
cases.explain: «восточных народов» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Then Jacob went on his journey, and came to the land of the children of the east.

cases.explain: «большим камнем» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: He looked, and behold, a well in the field, and saw three flocks of sheep lying there by it. For out of that well they watered the flocks. The stone on the well’s mouth was large.
